name: gravity and all four line directions determine the winner
input: vertical horizontal and diagonal winning sequences
test:
vertical = ConnectKGame(4, 4, 3)
for player, column in ((Player.X, 1), (Player.O, 0), (Player.X, 1), (Player.O, 0), (Player.X, 1)):
    status = vertical.make_move(player, column)
assert status is GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS
horizontal = ConnectKGame(3, 4, 3)
for player, column in ((Player.X, 0), (Player.O, 3), (Player.X, 1), (Player.O, 3), (Player.X, 2)):
    status = horizontal.make_move(player, column)
assert status is GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS
diagonal = ConnectKGame(4, 4, 3)
for player, column in ((Player.X, 0), (Player.O, 1), (Player.X, 1), (Player.O, 2), (Player.X, 3), (Player.O, 2), (Player.X, 2)):
    status = diagonal.make_move(player, column)
assert status is GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS

name: turn ownership and invalid or full columns are rejected
input: wrong player out-of-range and a full column

name: K one terminal moves and board-filling moves have the right precedence
input: a first-move win and an unwinnable full board
test:
one = ConnectKGame(2, 2, 1)
assert one.make_move(Player.X, 0) is GameStatus.PLAYER_X_WINS
try:
    one.make_move(Player.O, 1)
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
except ValueError:
    pass
draw = ConnectKGame(2, 2, 3)
for player, column in ((Player.X, 0), (Player.O, 1), (Player.X, 0), (Player.O, 1)):
    status = draw.make_move(player, column)
assert status is GameStatus.DRAW
